operator_lock: PhoneBio was (also) to use local sensors to determine how many people, to help with voice distinguishing, as a tertiary goal — while using the vault and quant models.

means.local_sensors: On-device / edge sensors (mic acoustic events, BLE/UWB proximity, motion/vibration, etc. — camera-free per PhoneBio premise)
means.people_estimate: Presence-class estimate of how many people are nearby (helps diarization / voice distinguishing) — not biometric identity
means.voice_distinguishing: Tertiary aid: separate speakers / voice leaves when more than one person may be present

allowed: local-sensor presence / people-count estimate as tertiary goal
use of that estimate to help voice distinguishing / diarization
tertiary people→voice goal runs with user custody vault
local quantized models for edge sensor labels / presence triage (fail-soft)
forbidden: exact headcount claimed from sensors alone as proven fact
biometric identity / who-is-speaking legal ID claims
camera-based people counting (out of PhoneBio camera-free premise)
elevating people-count/voice-distinguish above core field-protocol voice assistance without OPERATOR re-prioritize
WorkOS Vault as the PhoneBio Merkle-root / user vault SoT
quant model output as protocol/safety authority (tools/records remain SoT)
cloud LLM required for tertiary people→voice path

lineage_surfaces: docs/DEMO_VIDEO_SCRIPT.md (nearby people; no exact identity/headcount claim)
docs/VAPI_RUNBOOK.md (possible overlap/equipment nearby, not identity or exact headcount)

vault.sense: User / FCO custody vault (Merkle-root authority stays user-side — Bitcoin-wallet style). Not WorkOS Vault product.
vault.role: Seal sensor/voice leaves and presence estimates under user-held root; sponsors/agents verify public commits only

quant_models.sense: Local quantized models (Ollama / ExecuTorch / in-browser quantized edge path) for on-device sensor labels and low-bandwidth triage
quant_models.role: Edge inference for presence/sensor context that feeds voice distinguishing — fail-soft; deterministic tools/records remain authority for protocols/safety

runtime_companions.together: Tertiary loop: local sensors + quant models produce presence/people estimates → help voice distinguishing; results/leaves sealed via user vault — PHI/presence privacy preserved
